US.description: Includes federal income tax, FICA (Social Security & Medicare), and an estimated average for state and local income taxes.

IN.description: Effective income tax including a 4% health and education cess, calculated for an individual under the new tax regime.

SG.description: Effective personal income tax rate for a resident on an $85k USD equivalent income, not including any social security contributions which are employer-borne.

CH.description: Includes federal, cantonal, and municipal income taxes, plus social security contributions; highly variable by canton and municipality.

NL.description: Effective rate includes income tax and national insurance premiums after standard credits.

GB.description: Effective rate includes Income Tax and National Insurance Contributions for an $85k USD earner.

CA.description: Effective tax rate includes federal and provincial income taxes, along with mandatory social contributions (CPP/EI).

AE.description: No personal income tax for individuals in the UAE.

NO.description: Effective rate includes state income tax, municipal income tax, and national insurance contributions.

IE.description: Includes national income tax, Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI).

LU.description: Includes progressive income tax, social security contributions, and health insurance.

AU.description: Includes federal income tax and Medicare levy for an $85k USD earner (approx $127,500 AUD).

QA.description: No personal income tax for residents on salaries and wages.

BN.description: Brunei Darussalam currently has no personal income tax for residents. Social security contributions are also minimal.

MO.description: Effective Professional Tax rate for an $85k USD earner, including progressive rates and exemptions specific to Macao SAR.
